pa:2610.31466.name: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
pa:2610.31466.desc: AnyGameRenderer is a video-to-video generative model that transforms low-quality agent-built game footage into high-fidelity visuals while preserving layout, camera, and entity timing.

pa:2610.29677.name: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
pa:2610.29677.desc: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operatin

pa:2610.20459.name: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
pa:2610.20459.desc: MolLean introduces a verifiable chemical reasoning framework with explicit molecular states, Lean-based verification, and interactive tool feedback to reduce hallucinations across generation and reaction tasks.

pa:2610.26252.name: SEAM: Spectral Embedding Alignment and Merging for Low-Resource TTS
pa:2610.26252.desc: SEAM initializes unseen token embeddings from subtokens via spectral filtering and ridge regression, reducing training data needs by 75% for low-resource text-to-speech vocabulary expansion.

pa:2610.30866.name: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
pa:2610.30866.desc: Verus-Insight improves AI-generated video detection by training artifact detectors through structured inspection planning, evidence verification, and evidence aggregation with human-anchored supervision.

pa:2610.31305.name: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
pa:2610.31305.desc: Cola2 improves hierarchical language generation by jointly optimizing continuous semantic compression, reconstruction-generation balance, and encoder-decoder co-adaptation via dynamic span segmentation, masked diffusion decoding, and flow-matching priors.

pa:2610.31494.name: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
pa:2610.31494.desc: AgentVQA is an offline benchmark assessing vision-language models on realistic agentic tasks across web, robotics, video, games, and spatial planning, revealing that visual grounding and state tracking errors are the primary failure modes.

pa:2610.25100.name: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
pa:2610.25100.desc: Deep Fusion Memory integrates predicted parametric memory into intermediate hidden states via gated cross-attention, reducing retrieval overhead and improving knowledge-intensive tasks without online retrieval.

pa:2610.30882.name: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
pa:2610.30882.desc: Reinforcement learning improves reasoning accuracy without requiring a specific wait marker, which originates from training data rather than RL, and automated evaluation metrics can misrepresent reasoning trends.

pa:2610.30181.name: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
pa:2610.30181.desc: OpenDS-World introduces a live-web benchmark to evaluate autonomous multi-step deep search agents, revealing significant gaps between frontier models and human performance.

pa:2610.31574.name: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
pa:2610.31574.desc: Test-time regression provides a learnable, closed-form alternative to pooling for compressing sequences in efficient language and multimodal models.

pa:2610.30755.name: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
pa:2610.30755.desc: Raw retrieval-augmented generation over unprocessed conversation history outperforms complex agentic memory systems across multiple benchmarks, indicating that preserving raw evidence is more critical than elaborate memory transformations.

pa:2610.31474.name: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
pa:2610.31474.desc: SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into skeleton-guided kinematic and residual components to improve controllable robot world modeling and motion transfer.

pa:2610.28889.name: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
pa:2610.28889.desc: Policy-Mask learns a budget-conditioned selection policy over diffusion timesteps, network blocks, and channels to extract compact, task-optimal features for discriminative vision tasks.

pa:2610.31158.name: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
pa:2610.31158.desc: Researchers introduce a benchmark and evaluation framework for video-centered deep research agents that synthesize external evidence into interactive reports linked to video moments.

pa:2610.31062.name: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
pa:2610.31062.desc: SCOPE compiles compound policies into optimized neural-symbolic programs that achieve high accuracy, stability, and interpretability on inexpensive models.

pa:2610.30340.name: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
pa:2610.30340.desc: Foundation4D is a unified feed-forward model that jointly estimates geometry, detects objects, predicts semantic occupancy, and reconstructs Gaussians from multi-camera driving video, achieving state-of-the-art results across several benchmarks.

pa:2610.27851.name: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
pa:2610.27851.desc: LaLa-World is a language-conditioned latent world model that jointly learns from diverse simulation, robot, and video data to enable efficient model-predictive planning and policy initialization.

pa:2610.30926.name: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
pa:2610.30926.desc: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning enables video diffusion transformers to leverage multimodal language model representations for sparse temporal inference and factor-aware cinematic control through staged grounding and optimization.
pa:2610.30926.zh: 讓AI看懂文字生成電影級影片，畫面更細膩流暢
pa:2610.30926.why: 結合文字模型的理解力，改善影片生成技術，讓畫面控制更精準且動作更自然

pa:2610.31668.name: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
pa:2610.31668.desc: This survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling, organizing progress around inferring, synthesizing, sharing, and interacting with latent temporal states to emphasize persistent dynamics over clip-level perception.
pa:2610.31668.zh: 讓電腦看懂影片並自己生成畫面，像人類一樣理解世界運作
pa:2610.31668.why: 把過去分開的影片辨識與生成技術結合，讓電腦不只看懂畫面，還能預測接下來會發生什麼事

pa:2610.27598.name: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
pa:2610.27598.desc: Shared meta-experts across layers reduce redundancy and improve efficiency compared to layer-specific local experts in mixture-of-experts models.

pa:2610.28416.name: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
pa:2610.28416.desc: Code2Video-Compass is a benchmark evaluating multimodal language models on code-based video generation across text, image, and video inputs, revealing significant challenges in complex dynamic and state-dependent tasks.

pa:2610.27233.name: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
pa:2610.27233.desc: MMedAgent-Plus is a multimodal medical agent that coordinates specialist AI models via a vision-language planner to execute multi-step clinical analyses with high accuracy and faithful synthesis.

pa:2610.26836.name: Same Simulation, Different Evidence: Where Retrieved Tool Output Costs LLM Agents Accuracy
pa:2610.26836.desc: Agent harnesses that retrieve long simulator outputs from files rather than including them in context cause GPT models to substitute their own approximations for authoritative results, reducing accuracy despite correct underlying computations.

pa:2610.26397.name: Bridged Self-Distillation for On-Policy Learning
pa:2610.26397.desc: Bridged Self-Distillation unifies on-policy reasoning transfer from any teacher by using privileged reasoning traces to score student rollouts and guide updates via outcome verification.

pa:2610.28441.name: Stratified Sparse Attention: Reducing the Sparse-to-Dense Gap at Extreme Sparsity
pa:2610.28441.desc: Stratified Sparse Attention unifies deterministic retrieval and score-guided sampling to recover attention mass, improving long-context inference accuracy and speed across multiple benchmarks.

pa:2610.22951.name: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
pa:2610.22951.desc: MambaAct replaces the transformer action expert in flow-matching VLA policies with a compact Mamba-based expert and a context compressor to cut inference latency while improving robotic manipulation success.

pa:2610.30468.name: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
pa:2610.30468.desc: SplatLab autonomously reproduces 3D Gaussian Splatting baselines, proposes extensions, and writes manuscripts with fully traceable training logs, improving PSNR by up to 3.78 dB.
pa:2610.30468.org: University of California at San Diego

pa:2610.20091.name: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
pa:2610.20091.desc: RTAformer separately models persistent entities and changing relations in video scene graphs by injecting calibrated query differences and aligning cross-frame instances to overcome relational semantic inertia.

pa:2610.30949.name: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
pa:2610.30949.desc: IQuest-Q1 is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts foundation model trained via multi-stage pre-training, mid-training, and post-training to achieve strong agentic coding and general capabilities.

pa:2610.31329.name: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
pa:2610.31329.desc: WeVisOne-VL unifies object-level and pixel-level visual perception via structured token prediction, supporting detection, localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting with a lightweight pixel decoder and multi-stage training.
pa:2610.31329.zh: 讓AI同時看懂整張圖片與細部位置
pa:2610.31329.why: 能同時處理物件偵測、文字辨識和去背等工作，比以往更輕量且精準

pa:2610.23987.name: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
pa:2610.23987.desc: GAFU leverages native generation-side representations to improve fine-grained visual understanding in unified multimodal models by compressing them into compact tokens for task-conditioned retrieval.

pa:2610.31576.name: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models
pa:2610.31576.desc: Optimized unmasking policies for masked diffusion language models improve efficiency by using trajectory-contraction targets with confidence and hidden states, achieving better speed-accuracy trade-offs with minimal overhead.

pa:2610.27712.name: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
pa:2610.27712.desc: RLSplat enables feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting with linear reductions in latency, memory, and model size by allocating Gaussians regionally and decoding them via local attention.

pa:2610.25376.name: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
pa:2610.25376.desc: TILDE distills embodied foundation model capabilities into robot policies via on-policy teacher supervision and autonomous recovery data collection, improving real-world task performance without large-scale action pretraining.

pa:2610.19705.name: RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing
pa:2610.19705.desc: RouteWeaver unifies heterogeneous LLM routing modes via coordinated training and progressive exploration, improving accuracy across diverse reasoning tasks.

pa:2610.26233.name: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
pa:2610.26233.desc: A heartbeat-style speculative reasoning approach lets voice agents continue preparing tool calls during speech updates, improving coverage and reducing response latency.

pa:2610.24738.name: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
pa:2610.24738.desc: LayerEditor unifies instruction-guided image editing with reusable RGBA layer generation via joint token modeling and edit-prior distillation, enabling precise local manipulation and layer reuse.
pa:2610.24738.zh: 把單張圖片拆解成可重複使用的透明圖層來編輯
pa:2610.24738.why: 能透過文字指令精準修改圖片局部，並將物件拆開獨立運用，比傳統編輯更靈活

pa:2610.31623.name: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
pa:2610.31623.desc: F2G-Pose is a real-time feed-forward framework that predicts category-level object pose, metric size, and completed shape from a single RGB-D image using dense visual features, DGCNN tokenization, and a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer.

pa:2610.30320.name: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
pa:2610.30320.desc: FRED improves single-step future video representations in world action models through self-distillation and temporal conditioning, boosting robot policy performance on long-horizon and unseen tasks.

pa:2610.27148.name: Who Takes the Lead? Model Ability and Task-Conditioned Collaboration with Humans
pa:2610.27148.desc: Researchers use a shared-control maze to show that stronger language-model agents selectively involve humans based on route advantage rather than failing to collaborate.

pa:2610.30753.name: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
pa:2610.30753.desc: FilmFlow is an agentic framework that translates natural-language or video instructions into executable camera trajectories for 3D scenes using specialized director, interpreter, scout, and critic agents, evaluated on the CinemaBench dataset.

pa:2610.31372.name: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
pa:2610.31372.desc: RIDAR detects and mitigates research integrity violations in autonomous agents via taxonomy-based post-hoc analysis and real-time intervention.

pa:2610.12586.name: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
pa:2610.12586.desc: Event sequence forecasting is evaluated as conditional generative modeling, revealing a trade-off between accuracy and realism, and a proposed algorithm converts realism into predictive accuracy.

pa:2610.31198.desc: T2Quant improves diffusion language model quantization by dynamically allocating activation precision across denoising steps based on predicted task- and time-dependent sensitivity.

pa:2610.24385.name: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
pa:2610.24385.desc: ID-TAP uses a neural dueling-bandit framework with similarity-weighted warm starts to adapt LLM agents to user preferences via binary response comparisons within a limited interaction budget.

pa:2610.24383.name: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems

pa:2610.31162.name: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
pa:2610.31162.desc: HiSTEVE is a hierarchical vision-language-action agent that combines long-horizon planning with native keyboard-and-mouse control to perform complex open-ended tasks in Minecraft.

pa:2610.17821.desc: Flow matching is investigated for four-source full-band stereo music separation, evaluating prediction targets, flow paths, modeling strategies, and consistency constraints with both signal-level and perceptual metrics.

pa:2610.32250.name: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
pa:2610.32250.desc: Easy-3Dfy separates object generation from scene layout estimation and uses geometric alignment to combine high-quality 3D objects with spatial understanding for improved scene reconstruction.

pa:2610.32253.name: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
pa:2610.32253.desc: RSIHub is an open-source framework that standardizes agent-evolution research by providing shared infrastructure for building, comparing, and extending methods with reusable components and consistent evaluation.

pa:2610.32965.name: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
pa:2610.32965.desc: RynnUnify is a 16B unified embodied model that integrates visual planning, physical reasoning, and robot control, achieving state-of-the-art results on long-horizon embodied tasks.

pa:2610.31569.name: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
pa:2610.31569.desc: Echo integrates stop and failure signals into a vision-language-action model to guide robot execution and recovery without fine-grained progress labels.

pa:2610.29552.name: Generalized CycleGRPO for Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding and Grounding
pa:2610.29552.desc: Generalized CycleGRPO unifies region understanding and localization via reinforcement learning with self-verified cycle consistency across images and videos, improving grounding and temporal distinctiveness without external judges.

pa:2610.30932.name: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
pa:2610.30932.desc: UserArena introduces a real-world interactive benchmark with long-horizon shopping trajectories and an evaluation framework, alongside On-Policy Trajectory Distillation to improve simulator fidelity for agentic recommendations.

pa:2610.31734.name: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
pa:2610.31734.desc: DirCast is a streaming video language model that simultaneously directs live esports broadcasts by selecting cameras and generates real-time commentary using only past context.

pa:2610.32909.name: HoloBoxing: A Simple Recipe for Humanoid Boxing with 7 Minutes of Single-GPU Training
pa:2610.32909.desc: HoloBoxing learns humanoid boxing by combining a frozen whole-body controller with a compact planner that predicts body-point targets, using imitation initialization and reinforcement learning to refine interaction behavior with minimal additional training.

pa:2610.27103.name: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
pa:2610.27103.desc: Omni-Woodpecker is a training-free framework that reduces cross-modal hallucinations in omni LLMs by identifying modality conflicts and rebalancing hidden representations to suppress misleading priors.

pa:2610.27782.name: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
pa:2610.27782.desc: Researchers introduce a benchmark and training dataset to evaluate multimodal language models as judges of physically valid, instruction-aligned embodied video generation, yielding a fine-tuned 9B judge with high human agreement.
pa:2610.27782.org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

pa:2610.14253.name: SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing
pa:2610.14253.desc: SlideBench benchmarks continuous image editing and SliderEdit++ improves slider reliability via trajectory regularization and disentanglement for smoother, faster control.

pa:2610.01352.name: MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
pa:2610.01352.desc: MMVistaReason improves open multimodal reasoning through structured data construction, difficulty-aware distillation, and specialized reinforcement learning integration.

pa:2610.14465.name: Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval
pa:2610.14465.desc: CoRE jointly learns reasoning rules and constrained evidence retrieval through alternating reinforcement and contrastive learning without predefined query-rule supervision.

pa:2610.31288.name: DISC: Domain-Integrated Similarity Cost for Time-Series Dataset
pa:2610.31288.desc: DISC is a learnable framework that calibrates and combines time-series dataset similarity metrics to better predict downstream forecasting transfer performance.

pa:2610.30006.name: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders
pa:2610.30006.desc: A pipeline using sparse autoencoders extracts interpretable linguistic features from neural detectors, yielding more accurate and explainable AI-generated text classification.

pa:2610.29477.name: TenetBench: A Clause-Anchored Russian Corpus for Evaluating Language Models against Professional Codes of Ethics
pa:2610.29477.desc: TenetBench evaluates whether language models adhere to professional ethical codes by pairing conflicting requests with benign equivalents, revealing frequent unflagged violations across most tested models.

pa:2610.24481.name: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
pa:2610.24481.desc: DuoLM accelerates personalized recommendation by combining a compact encoder and ranker with optimized inference, achieving high throughput with minimal quality loss.

pa:2606.00778.name: A path-following framework on fiber bundle for variational inequalities
pa:2606.00778.desc: A path-following framework on a fixed-point fiber bundle achieves global linear convergence for variational inequalities with continuous mappings over polytopes without monotonicity assumptions.

pa:2609.16158.name: The fixed-point bundle method over product-of-simplex domains arising from game equilibria
pa:2609.16158.desc: A fixed-point bundle framework extended to product-of-simplex domains via geometric equivalence yields globally convergent path-following algorithms for Nash equilibrium computation.

pa:2610.32770.name: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
pa:2610.32770.desc: Foundation models can self-improve across text and vision tasks by generating synthetic questions and reasoning traces guided only by high-level topics, without external supervision.

pa:2610.23234.name: MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
pa:2610.23234.desc: MultiAgent-OPD jointly trains a hierarchical multi-agent team via on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning, using a frozen teacher for local process supervision to improve end-to-end performance across multiple datasets.

pa:2610.32894.name: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
pa:2610.32894.desc: LoCA is a two-stage pipeline that trains co-aligned multimodal image encoders and uses them as high-rank targets to train location and metadata encoders via contrastive learning, outperforming existing methods across diverse geospatial tasks.

pa:2610.32002.name: DraMaze: A Multi-Agent Pipeline with Future-Aware Memory for Diverse Microdrama Script Generation
pa:2610.32002.desc: DraMaze improves long-form microdrama script generation by using evolutionary tree search guided by trope memory and backward narrative dependency trees to enhance plot diversity and coherence.

hf:WarmBloodAban/Minimax-h3_Singularity.name: WarmBloodAban/Minimax-h3_Singularity
hf:WarmBloodAban/Minimax-h3_Singularity.zh: 將靜態圖像轉換為動態影片的影音生成模型

pa:2610.31779.name: FLORA: An Open Model Suite for Scaling Robotics Data Engines
pa:2610.31779.desc: Flora is an open-source industrial data engine for robotics foundation models that provides captioning, outcome and process reward labeling, and pretraining data curation at scale with high accuracy and low cost.

pa:2610.20117.name: KANLab: TensorFlow Playground for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
pa:2610.20117.desc: KANLab is an interactive browser tool for teaching Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks by visualizing B-spline activation curves, gradient descent, and pruning in a compact 2D setting.

pa:2610.30524.name: LLM2Cert: LLM Synthesis of Certificates with SMT/Lean Verification
pa:2610.30524.desc: A benchmark of nonlinear dynamical systems and an LLM-driven framework that synthesizes and verifies stability and safety certificates via SMT solvers and proof repair agents achieve substantial verification improvements.

pa:2610.19589.name: JockeyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Horse-Racing Decision-Making
pa:2610.19589.desc: JockeyBench evaluates repeated event forecasting via Japanese horse racing, finding that reusable predictors improve efficiency but all configurations yield negative average betting returns.

pa:2610.31810.name: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
pa:2610.31810.desc: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. Starting from the LaTeX source, PaperFormalizer transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement

pa:2610.31819.name: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
pa:2610.31819.desc: This paper explores trading inference speed for output quality in speculative decoding by jointly adjusting diffusion effort and acceptance leniency to extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier.

pa:2610.28655.name: What Git Does Not Record: Provenance Legibility in Two AI-Assisted Research Repositories
pa:2610.28655.desc: Repository traces of AI use in computational research are partially visible and unreliable for measuring involvement, requiring auditable provenance systems.

pa:2610.31423.name: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
pa:2610.31423.desc: FocusVLA improves robotic manipulation by dynamically routing between global and local camera views based on predicted interaction intent across task stages.
pa:2610.31423.org: Technology Center of Software Engineering of ISCAS

pa:2610.31716.name: Does LeWorldModel Preserve Local Action Geometry?
pa:2610.31716.desc: Pretrained LeWorldModel's reproduction of small action effects is evaluated via Gram matrices across perturbation scales, showing scale-dependent sensitivity differences and higher errors than environment references.

sp:FastVideo/FastH3-Omni.name: FastVideo/FastH3-Omni
sp:FastVideo/FastH3-Omni.zh: 基於 Gradio 的高效影片生成與處理互動介面

pa:2610.25118.name: How Much Feedback Is Needed to Break Template Protection? The Geometric Vulnerability of Biometric Authentication
pa:2610.25118.desc: Biometric authentication leaks geometric information enabling precise template reconstruction from binary feedback, and diffusion priors reduce query costs significantly.

pa:2610.21109.name: Kolab: Benchmarking Human-Agent Collaboration in Long-Horizon Workflows
pa:2610.21109.desc: Kolab is a dataset of professional screen recordings that reveals frontier AI agents overestimate collaboration quality and fail to predict expert adoption of contributions in long-horizon workflows.

pa:2610.27364.name: Predictive Closure: A Set-Level Characterization of JEPA's Feature Selection
pa:2610.27364.desc: JEPA feature selection depends on predictive relationships between features rather than individual predictability, allowing unpredictable but relationally useful features to be retained and enabling indirect steering of representations.

pa:2610.27528.name: Judging the Justification: Decision Certificate Supervision for Generative Reward Models
pa:2610.27528.desc: DeCert evaluates and improves generative reward model rationales by assessing justification validity and verdict consistency without reference explanations, yielding stronger preference supervision.

pa:2610.31572.name: On the Token Collapse Phenomenon in Textual Graph Soft Prompting
pa:2610.31572.desc: Graph soft prompting in LLMs suffers from token collapse, where learned graph tokens become indistinguishable and function as generic prompts rather than conveying relational structure, prompting evaluation via alignment probes rather than accuracy alone.

sp:WizardTY/GEAR.zh: 社群展示用的實驗性互動介面

pa:2610.35518.name: S3AC: Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning
pa:2610.35518.desc: S3AC introduces a stabilized actor-critic training method with difficulty-aware prompt sampling to improve long reasoning in large language models without relying on grouped rollouts.

pa:2610.31635.name: HiP3R: Hierarchical Pose Graphs for Long-Horizon 3D Reconstruction
pa:2610.31635.desc: HiP3R uses a hierarchical pose graph to merge local video reconstructions into globally consistent camera trajectories and 3D geometry without retraining.

pa:2610.35434.name: Skill^{infty}: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
pa:2610.35434.desc: Skill∞ enables recursive self-improvement by letting a meta agent optimize both task skills and its own meta-skill through a reusable, agent-led procedure, improving performance across diverse domains.

pa:2610.34415.name: Spatial Audio Generation and Editing with Executable Plans and Self-Distilling Transfusion
pa:2610.34415.desc: AMBIT is a unified framework that generates and edits first-order ambisonics audio by coupling autoregressive scene planning with rectified-flow rendering, using a specialized continuous VAE and on-policy self-distillation to preserve spatial structure and acoustic fidelity.

pa:2610.33512.name: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL
pa:2610.33512.desc: FORK jointly optimizes recall and precision via rubric-driven necessity credits and factual grading to improve response quality and reduce verbosity in reinforcement learning.

pa:2610.33845.name: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
pa:2610.33845.desc: AutoTavern demonstrates that self-improving LLM research agents can autonomously build a faithful game simulator and train a reinforcement learning agent that surpasses top human players in Hearthstone Battlegrounds.

pa:2610.34356.name: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
pa:2610.34356.desc: RynnVLA-Latent leverages latent actions derived from diverse video to pretrain large vision-language-action policies, achieving high success across simulated and real-world robot benchmarks without embodiment-specific tuning.

pa:2610.35193.name: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement in the Era of Large Models: Foundation, Risks, Evaluation and Open Challenges
pa:2610.35193.desc: This survey defines recursive self-improvement and organizes trustworthy advancement requirements into improvement validity, constraint preservation, and oversight across recursive update stages.

pa:2610.23928.name: miniTE: Diagnosing and Bridging the Execution Gap in Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.23928.desc: MiniTE enables stable low-bit reinforcement learning for large language models by aligning cross-engine numerical execution and accelerating native 4-bit computation.

pa:2610.34467.name: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
pa:2610.34467.desc: DynaFlow enables adaptive multi-agent collaboration by letting a main agent synthesize executable workflows that coordinate sub-agents through structured execution and verification.
pa:2610.34467.zh: 讓多個 AI 自動分工合作，彈性完成複雜任務
pa:2610.34467.why: 讓主控 AI 自己安排其他小幫手的工作流程，合作更有效率

pa:2610.34238.name: Δτ-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability
pa:2610.34238.desc: Δτ-Bench evaluates agent adaptability to evolving tool ecosystems, and Steward improves sustained success through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic provisioning.

pa:2610.34634.name: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
pa:2610.34634.desc: AgentProofBench evaluates reusable web-agent verification by linking frozen acceptance rules to execution traces, establishing baseline measurements for program-gate correctness and reuse.

pa:2610.33503.name: Novel or Not? PatEx-Gym: Agentic Prior-Art Search for Novelty Assessment in Patent Examination
pa:2610.33503.desc: PatEx-Gym introduces a framework with benchmarks, synthetic trajectory data, and a compact agent to evaluate iterative prior-art search and patent examination.

pa:2610.18683.name: ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.18683.desc: ProAS improves credit assignment in critic-free reinforcement learning for LLM agents by using a dynamic reference graph to mask unreasonable incentives and redistribute penalties asymmetrically, boosting success rates and convergence speed.

pa:2610.35845.name: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
pa:2610.35845.desc: The paper proposes a unified framework for work agents that integrates foundation models with runtime harnesses to execute complex digital tasks reliably, introducing dimensions of persistence and openness alongside capability families and evaluation metrics.

pa:2610.33472.name: Qwen-Image-PE: Learning Visual Design for Text-to-Image Prompt Enhancement
pa:2610.33472.desc: Qwen-Image-PE improves text-to-image prompts via two-stage training with caption-based reverse distillation and groupwise design rewards, scaling across data, model size, and information density.

pa:2610.31309.name: Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cross-Layer Latent Vector Quantization
pa:2610.31309.desc: OPTIC achieves extreme compression of per-layer embeddings by using token-shared indexed codes and layer-specific affine decoders fitted to the output path, preserving most model performance at up to 1000x compression with minimal inference overhead.

pa:2610.34662.name: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
pa:2610.34662.desc: StreamVibe introduces a benchmark, streaming vision-language model, and hierarchical memory harness to enable proactive, intent-aware interaction with implicit and evolving user goals.
pa:2610.34662.zh: 會看影片並主動懂你心意的 AI 助理
pa:2610.34662.why: 結合影片理解與長期記憶，能在你沒開口前就預測你的需求並主動協助

pa:2610.33568.name: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
pa:2610.33568.desc: Trajectory2Gym improves tool-use training by constructing interactions with compositional coverage and decision grounding rather than collecting successful trajectories.
pa:2610.33568.zh: 教 AI 學會靈活使用工具，不用死背成功示範
pa:2610.33568.why: 讓 AI 自己組合各種互動情境來練習用工具，比以前更聰明且適應各種狀況

pa:2610.33966.name: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
pa:2610.33966.desc: InteractiveWorld provides a verifiable simulation environment and benchmark to evaluate whether multimodal language models can reliably guide humans through physical tasks.

pa:2610.32195.name: Principia: Test-Time Hypotheses to Principle Construction for Scientific Discovery
pa:2610.32195.desc: Principia is an LLM-based framework that builds and iteratively refines scientific principles during inference to accelerate discovery across molecular and biological tasks.

pa:2610.33169.name: World-in-Context: Interactive Video World Modeling with In-Context Conditioning
pa:2610.33169.desc: World-in-Context unifies view, action, and camera controls via explicit tokens and interaction-aware positional encoding to improve interactive video generation and navigation.

pa:2610.33956.name: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
pa:2610.33956.desc: A new benchmark evaluates whether LLM agents improve through repeated professional tasks with feedback, revealing limited sustained learning in current frontier models.

pa:2610.32285.name: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
pa:2610.32285.desc: TraceTrial-Bench evaluates agent harness reliability across seven components using mechanism-oriented tasks, trajectory tracing, and failure attribution to compare harness designs and diagnose failures.
pa:2610.32285.zh: 幫 AI 助理做健康檢查，找出哪裡容易出包
pa:2610.32285.why: 幫忙找出自動化系統常失敗的原因，讓 AI 運作更穩定可靠

pa:2610.29139.name: Steering Black-Box Large Language Model Agents with Pitfall Anticipation World Model
pa:2610.29139.desc: PAWM selectively predicts multi-step failures to guide black-box LLM agents away from pitfalls, improving performance via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement co-training.

pa:2610.33135.name: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
pa:2610.33135.desc: CLACT and WorldCast enable consistent character video generation under large-angle camera motions by combining 3D point-cloud guidance with geometry-aligned memory attention.

pa:2610.27597.name: WORTH Benchmark: Evidence Discovery under Not-Fully-Cooperative Information -- A Two-Episode Pilot
pa:2610.27597.desc: The WORTH Benchmark evaluates autonomous evidence discovery and reasoning in mystery narratives, revealing that models select clues and participants inconsistently due to narrative structure.

pa:2610.32093.name: DiscoDemo: Discovering Efficient and Diverse Robot Demonstrations for Imitation Learning
pa:2610.32093.desc: DiscoDemo uses reinforcement learning to generate diverse successful robot manipulation trajectories for training more robust visuomotor imitation policies.

pa:2610.19687.name: Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization
pa:2610.19687.desc: Function-Space Policy Optimization improves reasoning and tool-use accuracy by combining temporal consolidation with privileged adaptation, reducing memory use and outperforming baselines.

gh:HKUDS/DeepTutor.zh: 港大推出的個人化終身AI家政教學系統

pa:2610.35450.name: OBB-PBD: Extending Parallel Box Decoding to Oriented Bounding Boxes for Referring Expression Grounding in Aerial Imagery
pa:2610.35450.desc: The study extends parallel box decoding to oriented bounding boxes via double-angle parameterization, validates it with control probes, and improves rotated IoU on aerial vehicle visual grounding.

pa:2610.33718.name: RoboJev: An Open Vision-Language Judge for Robot Success Detection
pa:2610.33718.desc: RoboJev-27B is an open-weight vision-language model that predicts robot manipulation success from video frames using LoRA fine-tuning, calibrated token readouts, and source-specific regularization, achieving high accuracy and generalization across labs and robots.

pa:2610.33024.name: Evolving to Match Capabilities: Improving Harness Self-Evolution via Skill Adaptation
pa:2610.33024.desc: Harness self-evolution improves LLM agents via skill adaptation guided by a meta-skill that reformulates guidance to match executor capabilities, boosting weak models without parameter updates.
pa:2610.33024.org: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

pa:2610.35328.name: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial? Revisiting Its Impact on LLM Performance
pa:2610.35328.desc: Constrained decoding does not inherently harm reasoning; its effects depend on constraint type, with validity and reasoning constraints often improving reliability and accuracy by removing invalid paths.

pa:2610.21561.name: DialFork: Going Beyond Factuality to Evaluate Procedural Hallucination in Conversational Agents
pa:2610.21561.desc: DialFork introduces a benchmark and flow-aware metrics to detect procedural hallucinations in conversational agents by measuring dialogue-level process deviation rather than content similarity.

pa:2610.33732.name: Trust Mechanisms for Offline Generative AI at the Edge: A Connectivity-Regime Framework and an Empirical Study on a Raspberry Pi 5
pa:2610.33732.desc: Local retrieval-augmented generation on edge devices using signed knowledge packs and output validators improves efficiency but remains vulnerable to poisoned updates and cannot guarantee evidence truth.

pa:2610.29915.name: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
pa:2610.29915.desc: CausalAlign improves long-horizon camera ego-motion consistency in diffusion video generators by aligning internal representations to 3D dynamics via delta-token space.

pa:2610.33413.name: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
pa:2610.33413.desc: AV-FABLE introduces a long-form audio-visual benchmark for sparse manipulations, showing that frozen perception features of audio-visual large language models contain forensic evidence best recovered via separate temporal decoders rather than language outputs.

pa:2610.30970.name: Joint or Per-Option? Compact Encoders for Closed-Set Decisions from 17 Million to 1 Billion Parameters
pa:2610.30970.desc: Many language-model pipelines end in a closed-set decision, such as selecting a tool. Prompting a large language model for it is slow and order-sensitive. We ask how small an encoder for such decisions can be and whether it should read the options jointly or separately. pa:2610.35001.name: More Memory, Better Videos? A Controlled Study of Visual Memory in Long-Video Generation
pa:2610.35001.desc: Visual memory improves historical consistency but can reduce current-story accuracy by reinforcing outdated appearances, showing that retrieval relevance alone does not prove memory utility.

pa:2610.14018.name: RoboHarness: A Simple Harness Outperforms VLA and World Action Models
pa:2610.14018.desc: RoboHarness enables LLM agents to perform embodied manipulation via a visual-geometric control interface, surpassing specialized vision-language-action models on robotics benchmarks.

pa:2610.34654.name: Thinking-in-Bets at Test Time Reduces Sycophantic Revisions in LLM Agents
pa:2610.34654.desc: Thinking-in-Bets improves agent reliability by having models record verified claims before receiving user feedback, reducing false reversals and unnecessary edits while maintaining accuracy.

pa:2610.24451.name: Assessing the CAD Capabilities of General-Purpose AI Models: A Case Study of GPT-6 Astra
pa:2610.24451.desc: GPT-6 Astra demonstrates partial capability across CAD workflows but remains limited by geometric validity, parametric dependencies, and assembly errors.

pa:2610.34241.name: Beyond Benchmarks: Can Small Open-Weight Models Get Real Coding Work Done?
pa:2610.34241.desc: Empirical studies of open-weight coding agents reveal that verified code success depends on serving setup, protocol design, and hidden behavioral checks rather than text coherence alone.

pa:2610.35385.name: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
pa:2610.35385.desc: EmbodiedLab evaluates embodied agents that must physically interact with simulated laboratory apparatus to discover scientific principles through self-directed experimentation.

pa:2610.33079.name: Rethinking Video Storage for AI Training: Breaking Cross-Frame Dependencies for Efficient Random Access
pa:2610.33079.desc: Co-designed sparse decoding and dependency-decoupled encoding reduce video decode overhead for random AI training sampling by bounding reconstruction per target.

pa:2610.31818.name: Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning
pa:2610.31818.desc: Nestor introduces nested sparsity in attention to improve conditional computation over standard mixture-of-experts transformers, enhancing pretraining, long-context adaptation, and continual learning.

pa:2610.33608.name: Mycelium: A Meta-Study of Hallucination Detection Across Provenance, Typology, and Granularities
pa:2610.33608.desc: Hallucination detection is analyzed as a benchmark-conditioned measurement problem across provenance, typology, and granularity axes, with a proposed Span Coverage F1 metric to address span-level evaluation variability.
pa:2610.33608.org: Detection, Optimization, Generation and Semantics Lab

pa:2610.34149.name: Humans in Space: Can MLLMs Construct Human-Centric Spatial Understanding via Active Exocentric Exploration?
pa:2610.34149.desc: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at zero-shot reasoning, their spatial capabilities are primarily evaluated through static, passive observation. In complex, human-centric scenes, occlusion often hides crucial geometric evidence, and passive benchmarks force models to guess rather than recognize their own visual uncertainty. pa:2610.32004.name: CRM-Agent-Bench: Benchmarking Tool-Using Agents in Stateful Enterprise Environments
pa:2610.32004.desc: The study introduces an execution-grounded benchmark for evaluating deployable language agents on multi-turn business tasks using strict contract-based success criteria across outcome, trajectory, viability, and compliance.

pa:2610.17117.name: Gluing Local Contexts into Global Meaning: A Sheaf-Theoretic Decomposition of Transformer Representations
pa:2610.17117.desc: A cellular sheaf built over paraphrase graphs extracts content subspaces and influence directions from frozen language models, improving fact retrieval and revealing architectural fragility via harmonic analysis.

pa:2610.34886.name: ThinkBit: Search Codewords, Recalibrate Scales, Select by Reasoning
pa:2610.34886.desc: ThinkBit is a scalar two-bit quantization framework that preserves reasoning by assigning layerwise bit tiers, optimizing codewords via Gumbel-softmax, and recalibrating with knowledge distillation followed by quantization-aware training.

pa:2610.34735.name: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
pa:2610.34735.desc: The study introduces iPrefBench, a benchmark for assessing whether mobile agents can infer missing user preferences from activity history or ask for necessary clarification, revealing that current agents execute actions well but fail at personalization.

pa:2610.33877.name: Semantic Concept Steering Breaks the Explanation Drift Loop in Continual Learning
pa:2610.33877.desc: C3L prevents explanation drift in continual learning by anchoring saliency regularization to offline-discovered semantic concepts, suppressing spurious correlations through a relevance crowding-out effect.

pa:2610.28490.name: Learning from Automatic 3D Gaussian Splatting Edits for Online Bayesian Scene Change Detection
pa:2610.28490.desc: The method learns scene-specific evidence models and priors from automatically edited 3D Gaussian Splatting representations to perform efficient online change detection via Bayesian fusion and object-guided refinement.

pa:2610.34638.name: Intrinsic Goals for Autonomous Agents: Hierarchical Exploration Captures Future Volitional Action in Drosophila
pa:2610.34638.desc: Hierarchical intrinsically motivated agents trained with competency-based objectives replicate fruit fly exploratory behavior and neural representations of future actions, supporting reverse-engineering of autonomous decision-making.

pa:2610.19025.name: How Far Can Coding Agents Go in Visual Generation?
pa:2610.19025.desc: Coding agents build images via executable programs, showing structured visual reasoning and consistent internal scene representations across drawing interfaces.

pa:2610.21240.name: Representation Redistribution in Sparse Autoencoders
pa:2610.21240.desc: Sparse autoencoders decompose language model activations into sparse features, and the redistribution sensitivity score identifies recurring feature changes that contribute to downstream readout failures without equating representation change with failure.

pa:2610.33817.name: EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact
pa:2610.33817.desc: EnvLunch leverages executable environments to generate verifiable training trajectories without human annotations, improving agent performance and reducing labeled data requirements for downstream tasks.

pa:2610.32046.name: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
pa:2610.32046.desc: Test-Time Memory Evolution updates external memory without changing model weights to guide scientific discovery more efficiently than test-time training.

pa:2610.35295.name: Did the Model Use That? Counterfactual Training Boosts Self-Attribution in Language Models
pa:2610.35295.desc: CREDIT improves language model self-attribution of external information via counterfactual training, reducing false acknowledgment of non-influential sources.

pa:2610.34577.name: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
pa:2610.34577.desc: Verification strategies for agent harnesses—spanning instructions, reminders, gates, and independent review—show that independent critic review improves accuracy with minimal cost increases, guiding practical test-time scaling design.

pa:2610.33861.name: ReGE: Stronger Agents through Experience Synthesis
pa:2610.33861.desc: ReGE converts recorded agent execution experience into synthesized guidance to improve subsequent task attempts without requiring stronger teachers or parameter updates.

pa:2610.35864.name: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
pa:2610.35864.desc: VibeVideoBench evaluates multimodal agents that generate videos via code, finding that top systems meet core requirements on most tasks but frequently fail due to poor time management.

pa:2610.36791.name: RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
pa:2610.36791.desc: RynnWorld-Latent learns cross-embodiment world dynamics via 3D-grounded latent actions, enabling joint pretraining on diverse video sources and synthetic data generation for improved robot policy performance.

pa:2610.37381.name: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
pa:2610.37381.desc: PDRVLA improves robot action generation by integrating a lightweight physical dynamics module that predicts future visual features with world-model supervision, avoiding online video generation latency.

pa:2610.37255.name: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
pa:2610.37255.desc: Under KL-regularized control, a policy encodes its harness preferences, so deployed performance equals harness potential minus policy mismatch, and harness comparisons must separate these terms to predict training gains.

pa:2610.34674.name: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
pa:2610.34674.desc: The study introduces a benchmark and metric to evaluate whether robot navigation policies adapt continuous motion to obstacle safety semantics, revealing a gap in translating semantic caution into safe movement.

pa:2610.36077.name: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
pa:2610.36077.desc: The Trinity framework recursively improves multimodal agents by organizing tasks into a capability tree, generating simulated training worlds, and routing specialized harness modules to boost performance on diverse benchmarks.

pa:2610.34921.name: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
pa:2610.34921.desc: Physevolve trains vision-language models in causal physical reasoning by using a physics engine to validate self-generated executable worlds and counterfactual simulations, improving performance on dynamics benchmarks without human data.

pa:2610.26185.name: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching
pa:2610.26185.desc: MoveBench introduces a specialized benchmark for evaluating large language models on sports and health coaching, emphasizing safety, scientific validity, and personalization across multiple-choice and open-ended tasks.

pa:2610.37175.name: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
pa:2610.37175.desc: A world model predicts machine learning program outcomes to enable affordable test-time scaling for AI research agents, improving performance with fewer real executions.

pa:2610.37219.name: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
pa:2610.37219.desc: Just Action Model decouples backbone initialization, future observation objectives, and inference machinery to improve robot control with foresight training and reduced computation.

pa:2610.37585.name: Timestral
pa:2610.37585.desc: Timestral is a family of time series foundation models that achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting through decoupled horizon forecasting, native future covariate support, and synthetic pretraining followed by mixed post-training.

pa:2610.36022.name: Learning and Reasoning with Geometry: How Generation Helps Spatial Understanding
pa:2610.36022.desc: GeoUG improves spatial reasoning by combining depth and multi-view generation with adaptive geometric verification during inference.

pa:2610.37386.name: Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
pa:2610.37386.desc: Prox replaces calibrated thresholds with top-k channel selection and a weight-derived reader to accelerate Mixture-of-Experts inference while preserving accuracy.

pa:2610.33066.name: OvisOCR3 Technical Report
pa:2610.33066.desc: OvisOCR3 is a compact 0.8B vision-language model that unifies diverse OCR tasks through multi-teacher distillation and reinforcement learning, achieving state-of-the-art results across document parsing, general OCR, key information extraction, figure captioning, and cross-page table reconstruction.

pa:2610.37341.name: CodeCap-Bench: Can Code Serve as a Good Video Caption?
pa:2610.37341.desc: Executable code representations of video content improve reasoning and reconstruction over natural language, yet current multimodal models still struggle to generate faithful code captions for complex temporal dynamics.

pa:2610.34073.name: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
pa:2610.34073.desc: Large-scale evaluation reveals that dedicated memory systems often underperform naive retrieval-augmented generation, introducing a framework of memory benefit and memory tax to assess net value.

pa:2610.37666.name: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
pa:2610.37666.desc: ThinkWorld improves robotic generalization by representing actions as dynamics chains and using world imagination to learn from unlabeled human videos.

pa:2610.35724.name: MatAnyone-E: Sparse Memory Propagation for Efficient High-Resolution Video Matting
pa:2610.35724.desc: MatAnyone-E accelerates high-resolution video matting by selectively applying high-resolution matching to uncertain regions and using a lightweight decoder, achieving large speedups with preserved quality.

pa:2610.35439.name: Omni-InteractScope: Benchmarking Proactive and Agentic Interaction in Continuous Omnimodal Streams
pa:2610.35439.desc: Omni-InteractScope evaluates continuous audiovisual interaction reliability, revealing that current Omni-LLMs struggle with timely tool use, query-free reminders, and sustained guidance.

pa:2610.24520.name: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
pa:2610.24520.desc: HABIT-Bench evaluates whether LLM agent memory systems can infer implicit user habits from sparse dialogue evidence and apply them correctly across long-term interactions.

pa:2610.34714.name: SearchHorizonBench: A Benchmark for Search Value in AI Agents
pa:2610.34714.desc: SearchHorizonBench evaluates how agents learn to estimate the value of additional search from execution history, showing that historical calibration improves prediction accuracy but leaves most search-gain variance unexplained.

pa:2610.36729.name: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
pa:2610.36729.desc: Hy-Nomas is a video world model that uses causal attention and structured captions to follow multi-turn text and camera instructions while preserving interaction history.

pa:2610.37649.name: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
pa:2610.37649.desc: LongChang evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously discover altered physical laws through simulated experimentation, finding that only one model achieved limited success.

pa:2610.34724.name: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
pa:2610.34724.desc: HaMo combines rapid retrieval of procedural experience cards with gradual model adaptation to improve long-horizon web agents' retention and cross-task execution.

pa:2610.34491.name: What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents
pa:2610.34491.desc: Reasoning effort in generative models acts as a credence good where higher compute does not guarantee better instance-level results, and an escalation strategy from low effort improves cost-efficiency.

pa:2610.36466.name: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation
pa:2610.36466.desc: NLD-Uni is a unified discrete diffusion language model that combines visual understanding and generation via cross-paradigm on-policy distillation and progressive self-refining diffusion.

pa:2610.33624.name: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
pa:2610.33624.desc: RSI Arena demonstrates that autonomous AI agents can independently train and iteratively improve language models using human feedback, with most agents achieving preference gains in a second stage despite modest benchmark improvements.

pa:2610.34283.name: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
pa:2610.34283.desc: ChronoReplay mitigates interface lock-in in spatial vision-language models by replaying heterogeneous spatial supervision chronologically, improving cross-task transfer and enabling efficient inference-time evidence selection.

pa:2610.36269.name: Cross-modal Steering Vectors Exist Across Both Image and Text Generation
pa:2610.36269.desc: Cross-modal steering vectors transfer between text and image generation in unified multimodal models, revealing shared causal control mechanisms despite a modality gap.

pa:2610.36456.name: LociArt: A Unified Paradigm for Free-Style Local Video Stylization
pa:2610.36456.desc: LociArt enables precise local video stylization with region-style control and temporal consistency via a generative refinement network, automated dataset construction, and a dedicated benchmark.

pa:2610.22543.name: On the SPOT: Enhancing Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Commit-Order Prediction
pa:2610.22543.desc: SPOT accelerates diffusion language models by predicting token generation order and verifying candidates in parallel, reducing passes up to 6.8x while maintaining exact decoding.

pa:2610.36068.name: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
pa:2610.36068.desc: Rollback improves robot policies by using world models to rewind to past decisions, explore counterfactual actions, and generate fine-grained supervision, while continuously refining dynamics via real-world feedback.

pa:2610.33005.name: OpenESM: Energy-Steered Models Are Scalable Foundation Learners
pa:2610.33005.desc: Energy-steered models integrate energy-guided latent optimization with token generation to improve foundational language modeling and scale effectively across diverse tasks.

pa:2610.31566.name: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
pa:2610.31566.desc: A new benchmark evaluates vision-language models on cell tracking against specialized algorithms, revealing reasoning gaps across diverse imaging modalities.

pa:2610.36420.name: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
pa:2610.36420.desc: A simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation on low-cost robot arms reveals that hybrid LLM agents outperform learned vision-language-action policies, with ranking consistency between simulation and real hardware.

pa:2610.32177.name: Ψ-0.6: Adaptive Streams of Thought in a Unified Vision-Language World Model
pa:2610.32177.desc: A unified vision-language world model adaptively combines perception, language, geometry, and simulation through interleaved reasoning streams to improve spatial reasoning and counterfactual simulation.

pa:2610.34386.name: ParetoRSI-Gym: Can AI Agents Improve Language Models Across Multiple Domains?
pa:2610.34386.desc: ParetoRSI-Gym evaluates recursive self-improvement agents across multiple domains by fixing the model and pipeline while allowing data curation and training loops, revealing significant generalization gains and distinct agent strategies.
